# Lead Japan 合同会社 コーポレートサイト Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** Build a free-to-host, JavaScript-free static corporate site for Lead Japan 合同会社 (7 HTML pages) generated by a Python standard-library script, with a Tokyo Tower hero and CSS scroll-driven reveal motion.

**Architecture:** All copy lives in one Python module (`sitegen/content.py`). `sitegen/pages.py` turns content into page bodies, `sitegen/render.py` wraps each body in a shared layout (header/nav/footer), and `build.py` writes `site/*.html` and copies `static/`. Motion is pure CSS (`animation-timeline: view()` inside `@supports`), so the site works with JS disabled and degrades to static content in browsers without scroll timelines. Hosting is GitHub Pages via a GitHub Actions workflow (free).

**Tech Stack:** Python 3.13 standard library only (`html`, `pathlib`, `shutil`, `dataclasses`, `datetime`, `unittest`, `html.parser`); HTML5; CSS (custom properties, scroll-driven animations); Google Fonts (Noto Sans JP / Noto Serif JP, free); hand-authored SVG illustration of the Tokyo skyline.

**Spec:** `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-19-lead-japan-corporate-site-requirements.md`

## Global Constraints

- No paid services: no paid hosting, form backends, stock photos, fonts or CDNs. Allowed external resource: `fonts.googleapis.com` / `fonts.gstatic.com` only.
- Languages: Python, HTML, CSS only. **No `<script>` tags, no `.js` files** in `site/`.
- Python: standard library only; no `pip install`. Target Python 3.13 (`python3`).
- Company name exactly `Lead Japan 合同会社`; English `Lead Japan LLC`.
- Company description copy (verbatim, typo-corrected): 「Lead Japan 合同会社は、日本を導き、世界の中で日本の立ち位置を発展していく思いを持って名付けた。日本の成長に寄与するかが、この会社の価値基準になる。」 — on the site it is rendered in polite form: 「Lead Japan 合同会社は、日本を導き、世界の中で日本の立ち位置を発展させていく。その思いを込めて名付けました。日本の成長に寄与するか――それが私たちの価値基準です。」
- Business names exactly: `AIソリューションの展開`, `コンサルティング`, `システム開発`, `出版`. システム開発 must list `プロジェクトマネジメント関連` and `スタートアップ向け業務システムの開発`.
- Book title exactly `外資系PM1年目の教科書`, described as 2026年刊行予定. Never state revenue figures.
- Headquarters: `東京都`.
- Unknown facts use the literal marker `【要入力】` (representative name, founding date, address detail, email). The build prints a warning listing them; it does not fail.
- All internal `href`/`src` are relative (no leading `/`) so the site works under `https://<user>.github.io/<repo>/` and from `file://`.
- Every page: `<html lang="ja">`, `<meta charset="utf-8">`, viewport meta, unique `<title>` of the form `<page> | Lead Japan 合同会社` (top page: `Lead Japan 合同会社 | 日本を導き、世界へ。`), `<meta name="description">`.
- Palette tokens (in `:root`): `--navy: #0b1f3a`, `--navy-2: #13315c`, `--tower: #e8380d` (Tokyo Tower international orange), `--gold: #c8a24a`, `--ink: #1a1a1a`, `--paper: #ffffff`, `--mist: #f3f5f8`.
- Hero headline exactly `日本を導き、世界へ。` with sub-copy `Lead Japan — Tokyo, Japan`.
- Output directory `site/` (git-ignored). Tests: `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v`.

## Review Focus

1. **Browsers without scroll-driven animations (Firefox, older Safari)** — every `.reveal` element must be fully visible; `opacity: 0` may appear only inside `@supports (animation-timeline: view())`. Test in Task 4: `test_hidden_state_only_inside_supports`.
2. **`prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`** — all reveal and hero animations off. Test in Task 4: `test_reduced_motion_disables_animation`.
3. **Hosting under a sub-path / opening from file://** — a leading `/` in any link breaks every page. Test in Task 7: `test_no_root_relative_urls`, plus `test_all_internal_links_resolve`.
4. **Phone width (375px)** — nav must collapse to a CSS-only (checkbox) menu, no horizontal scroll. Test in Task 2: `test_mobile_nav_toggle_markup`; manual check in Task 7 Step 5.
5. **Content containing `<`, `&`, quotes** — must be escaped, not break markup. Test in Task 2: `test_layout_escapes_title_and_description`, and Task 5: `test_business_text_is_escaped`.

### Task 2: Shared layout, base CSS, and minimal build

**Files:**
- Create: `sitegen/render.py`, `sitegen/pages.py` (Page type + empty `PAGES`), `build.py`, `static/css/style.css`, `static/img/favicon.svg`
- Test: `tests/helpers.py`, `tests/test_render.py`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `SITE`, `NAV`, `PLACEHOLDER` from Task 1.
- Produces:
  - `render.esc(s: object) -> str` — `html.escape(str(s), quote=True)`
  - `render.render_layout(*, title: str, description: str, body: str, current: str) -> str` — full HTML document; `current` is the page filename and gets `aria-current="page"` on its nav link. `body` is trusted HTML; `title`/`description` are escaped.
  - `render.find_placeholders(text: str) -> int` — count of `PLACEHOLDER` occurrences
  - `pages.Page` = `@dataclass(frozen=True) Page(filename: str, title: str, description: str, body: Callable[[], str])`
  - `pages.PAGES: list[Page]` (filled by Tasks 3, 5, 6)
  - `build.build(out_dir: pathlib.Path) -> list[pathlib.Path]` — deletes and recreates `out_dir`, writes each page as UTF-8, copies `static/` to `out_dir/static/`, returns written HTML paths; `main()` builds to `site/` and prints `警告: 【要入力】 が N 箇所残っています (<files>)` when any remain.
  - `tests/helpers.py`: `class LinkCollector(html.parser.HTMLParser)` collecting `.links: list[str]` (href/src values), `.scripts: int`, `.title: str`; `def build_to_tmp() -> pathlib.Path` (builds into a `tempfile.mkdtemp()` dir).

Layout markup the tests pin:
- `<header class="site-header">` with logo link `index.html` (text `Lead Japan` + small `合同会社`), CSS-only menu: `<input type="checkbox" id="nav-toggle" class="nav-toggle">` + `<label for="nav-toggle" class="nav-toggle-label" aria-label="メニューを開く">` + `<nav class="global-nav" aria-label="グローバルナビゲーション">` with NAV links.
- `<main id="main">`; a skip link `<a class="skip-link" href="#main">本文へスキップ</a>` first in `<body>`.
- `<footer class="site-footer">`: company name, `東京都`, links to all NAV pages + `privacy.html`, `© 2026 Lead Japan LLC`.
- `<head>` links Google Fonts (`Noto+Sans+JP:wght@400;500;700` and `Noto+Serif+JP:wght@600;700`, `display=swap`), `static/css/style.css`, `static/css/motion.css`, favicon `static/img/favicon.svg`.

**Interfaces:**

- Produces: `pages.body_index() -> str`; `pages.news_list_html(items: Sequence[NewsItem]) -> str` (reused by Task 6) rendering `<ul class="news-list">` of `<li><time datetime="YYYY-MM-DD">YYYY.MM.DD</time><span class="news-cat">…</span><a href="news.html#news-YYYYMMDD-N">title</a></li>`; `pages.news_anchor(item: NewsItem, index: int) -> str` returning `news-YYYYMMDD-{index}`.

Top page sections (in order, each `<section class="section …">`; every block that should animate gets class `reveal`):
1. `.hero` — full viewport (`min-height: 100svh`), navy→deep-blue dusk gradient sky, `tokyo-skyline.svg` anchored bottom (`<img src="static/img/tokyo-skyline.svg" alt="東京タワーと東京の街並み">`), headline `<h1>日本を導き、世界へ。</h1>` (serif, `clamp(2.4rem, 7vw, 5.5rem)`, white), sub-copy `Lead Japan — Tokyo, Japan`, scroll cue `SCROLL` with a vertical line.
2. ABOUT — `SITE["philosophy"]`, `.btn` to `company.html`.
3. BUSINESS — 4 cards from `BUSINESSES` (number, title, title_en, summary), each links `business.html#<slug>`.
4. MESSAGE — short excerpt (first paragraph of `MESSAGE`), `.btn` to `message.html`.
5. NEWS — `news_list_html(NEWS[:3])`, `.btn` to `news.html`.
6. CONTACT CTA — navy band `お問い合わせはこちら` → `contact.html`.

SVG requirements (`tokyo-skyline.svg`, hand-written, `viewBox="0 0 1600 600"`, `preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMax slice"`): layered skyline silhouettes (3 depths, lighter navy far → near-black near), Tokyo Tower centered-right, ~45% of height, lattice drawn with `<path>` lines, alternating `--tower` orange / white bands at the two observation decks, small lit windows (`#ffd27a`, low opacity) scattered on near buildings, a top beacon `<circle id="beacon">`. Inline `<style>` in the SVG may animate the beacon blink (CSS keyframes inside SVG are allowed; no SVG `<script>`). Keep file < 60 KB.

### Task 4: Scroll-driven motion (CSS only)

**Files:**
- Create: `static/css/motion.css`
- Test: `tests/test_motion_css.py`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: class names `reveal`, `hero` from Task 3; optional modifiers `reveal--left`, `reveal--right`, `reveal--zoom`, and `style="--d: 1"`… (stagger index) that Tasks 3/5/6 may put on elements.
- Produces: the motion contract — any element with `.reveal` fades/slides in as it enters the viewport.

Behavior:
- Hero on load (no scroll needed): headline rises in (`translateY(24px)`→0, 900ms, `cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1)`), sub-copy 300ms later, skyline slow zoom-out 1.08→1 over 2.4s, scroll-cue line loops.
- Inside `@supports (animation-timeline: view())`: `.reveal { animation: reveal linear both; animation-timeline: view(); animation-range: entry 0% cover 30%; }` with `@keyframes reveal { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(48px) } to { opacity: 1; transform: none } }`; modifiers change the `from` transform (`translateX(-64px)`, `translateX(64px)`, `scale(.92)`); stagger via `animation-range: entry calc(var(--d,0) * 6%) cover calc(30% + var(--d,0) * 6%)`.
- Also inside `@supports`: hero skyline parallax using `animation-timeline: scroll(root)` (translateY 0→80px over the first 100vh), and a thin `--tower` reading-progress bar `.site-header::after` scaled by `scroll(root)`.
- `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)`: `*, *::before, *::after { animation: none !important; transition: none !important; }` and `.reveal { opacity: 1 !important; transform: none !important; }`.

- [ ] **Step 1: Write the failing tests** in `tests/test_motion_css.py` (read `static/css/motion.css`; strip comments with a regex; locate the `@supports (animation-timeline: view())` block by brace matching via a helper `extract_block(css: str, prelude: str) -> str`):

```python
def test_hidden_state_only_inside_supports(self):
    css = strip_comments(read("static/css/motion.css"))
    inside = extract_block(css, "@supports (animation-timeline: view())")
    outside = css.replace(inside, "")
    self.assertIn("opacity: 0", inside)
    self.assertNotIn("opacity: 0", outside)
def test_reveal_uses_view_timeline(self):
    inside = extract_block(strip_comments(read("static/css/motion.css")), "@supports (animation-timeline: view())")
    self.assertIn("animation-timeline: view()", inside)
def test_reduced_motion_disables_animation(self):
    block = extract_block(strip_comments(read("static/css/motion.css")), "@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)")
    self.assertIn("animation: none !important", block)
def test_style_css_never_hides_reveal(self):
    css = strip_comments(read("static/css/style.css"))
    self.assertNotRegex(css, r"\.reveal[^{]*\{[^}]*opacity:\s*0")
```

Hero load animations run in every browser, so their keyframes (named `hero-*`) live outside `@supports` and may start at `opacity: 0` (the `both` fill ends visible). In `test_hidden_state_only_inside_supports`, compute `outside` with `strip_keyframes(css.replace(inside, ""), prefix="hero-")` — a test helper that removes `@keyframes hero-…{…}` blocks by brace matching — before asserting.

**Files:**
- Modify: `sitegen/pages.py`, `static/css/style.css`
- Test: `tests/test_pages.py` (append)

**Interfaces:**

```python
def test_writes_all_pages(self):
    names = sorted(p.name for p in self.out.glob("*.html"))
    self.assertEqual(names, sorted(["index.html","company.html","business.html","message.html",
                                    "news.html","privacy.html","contact.html","404.html"]))
def test_static_copied(self):
    self.assertTrue((self.out / "static/css/style.css").exists())
    self.assertTrue((self.out / "static/img/tokyo-skyline.svg").exists())
def test_no_root_relative_urls(self):
    for page in self.out.glob("*.html"):
        for link in collect(page).links:
            self.assertFalse(link.startswith("/"), f"{page.name}: {link}")
def test_all_internal_links_resolve(self):
    for page in self.out.glob("*.html"):
        for link in collect(page).links:
            if link.startswith(("http", "mailto:", "#")): continue
            path, _, frag = link.partition("#")
            target = self.out / path
            self.assertTrue(target.exists(), f"{page.name}: {link}")
            if frag:
                self.assertIn(f'id="{frag}"', target.read_text(encoding="utf-8"), f"{page.name}: {link}")
def test_no_javascript_anywhere(self):
    for page in self.out.glob("*.html"):
        self.assertEqual(collect(page).scripts, 0, page.name)
    self.assertEqual(list(self.out.rglob("*.js")), [])
def test_only_free_external_hosts(self):
    for page in self.out.glob("*.html"):
        for link in collect(page).links:
            if link.startswith("http"):
                self.assertRegex(link, r"^https://fonts\.(googleapis|gstatic)\.com/")
def test_unique_titles(self):
    titles = [collect(p).title for p in self.out.glob("*.html")]
    self.assertEqual(len(titles), len(set(titles)))
def test_placeholder_report(self):
    report = placeholder_report(list(self.out.glob("*.html")))
    self.assertTrue(all(v > 0 for v in report.values()))
```
